name: Clyde Raveron
source: A college dropout that works currently as a dishwasher at a nearby pizzeria. He has a somewhat defeatist attitude mainly due to his past failures. Despite this, he holds a considerable intellect and competitive nature that drives him to perform better than most would expect. He was unwittingly pulled into The Game of Fourtune thinking that it would be a means to get treatment for his ailing mother.
